integrity: Proof supplied with direct eigenvalue calculations and independent finite supplementary numerical tests. No assertion of independent verification or external certification.
limitations: The exact induced norms are restricted to real Hermitian matrices on a qubit–qudit system; no claim about complex induced, completely bounded, diamond, general qudit–qudit, or all-state entanglement detection norms. Historical and independent mathematical verification remain outstanding.
title: Sharp Hermitian correlation-projection norms on qubit–qudit systems
